company.name: Clara Analysis Team
company.mission: Analyze, review, and improve the Clara project through coordinated AI agent workflows

agents.title: Lead Architect
responsibilities: Review overall Clara project architecture
Prioritize analysis tasks across the team
Coordinate findings from all agents into actionable insights
Make strategic decisions about refactoring priorities

agents.title: Code Reviewer
responsibilities: Review Clara source code for quality and best practices
Identify code smells, anti-patterns, and technical debt
Suggest refactoring opportunities
Check for consistent coding style and conventions

agents.title: QA Analyst
responsibilities: Analyze test coverage across the Clara project
Identify untested edge cases and missing test scenarios
Review existing tests for correctness and completeness
Propose test improvements and new test cases

agents.title: Security Auditor
responsibilities: Scan Clara codebase for security vulnerabilities
Check for OWASP Top 10 issues
Review dependency security and known CVEs
Assess authentication, authorization, and data handling

agents.title: Documentation Analyst
responsibilities: Audit Clara project documentation completeness
Identify undocumented APIs, functions, and modules
Review README and onboarding documentation
Suggest documentation improvements and missing guides

goals.title: Complete Clara Code Analysis
goals.description: Perform a comprehensive analysis of the Clara project covering architecture, code quality, security, testing, and documentation
subgoals: Catalog all technical debt and code quality issues
